description: This file defines the Coupon model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for retrieving coupon data, product and category associations, managing coupon history, and validating coupon applicability.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: The Coupon class manages coupon retrieval, validation, and history recording in the OpenCart platform, enabling coupon-based discounts and offers within the shopping cart.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific coupon code, including its validity and applicable products/categories.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Fetches a coupon record directly from the database using the coupon code.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns a list of product IDs associated with a specified coupon.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of category IDs associated with a specified coupon.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Creates a record in the coupon history for tracking coupon usage.

methods.name: deleteHistoriesByOrderId
methods.description: Removes coupon history records linked to a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts the number of times a coupon has been used, based on history records.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByCustomerId
methods.description: Counts how many times a specific customer has used a particular coupon.
